sub_locations.name: Street of Lances
sub_locations.description: Street of Lances was walked by broadcryers who peddled their broadsheets to passers-by.

sub_locations.name: Seawind Alley
sub_locations.description: Seawind Alley was an alley notable for the ghostly voices that could be heard within the alley.

sub_locations.name: Heroes' Walk
sub_locations.description: Every year during the summer, Heroes' Garden and Heroes' Walk were both overtaken by the nobles of the Church of Siamorphe on their holy day, the Divine Pageantry.

sub_locations.name: Heroes' Garden
sub_locations.description: Heroes' Garden was one of the only public gardens in the city besides the City of the Dead.

sub_locations.name: Oar Alley
sub_locations.description: A minor avenue of hard-packed earth and [[gravel]] that extended off of [[Ship Street]] and terminated in a dead end.

sub_locations.name: New Olamn
sub_locations.description: The College of New Olamn, simply known as New Olamn, was a traditional bardic college

sub_locations.name: Deepwater Harbor
sub_locations.description: Thanks to continuous efforts by the [[Guild of Watermen]] and its [[merfolk]] population, the cold waters of Deepwater Harbor were exceptionally clean.

sub_locations.name: Deepwater Isle
sub_locations.description: Deepwater was the largest in a ring of islands that enclosed and protected [[Deepwater Harbor]].

sub_locations.name: T'Quession
sub_locations.description: T'Quession was a [[sea elf]] hamlet.

sub_locations.name: Philosopher's Court
sub_locations.description: Also known as the Foolsquare

sub_locations.name: Tsarnen Alley
sub_locations.description: Tsarnen Alley was a short, hard-packed dirt and gravel paved, alleyway. It was frequently walked down by pilgrims and priests on their way to the [[Plinth]].

sub_locations.name: River Square
sub_locations.description: River Square was a hard-packed dirt and gravel courtyard.

sub_locations.name: Tornsar Alley
sub_locations.description: Tornsar Alley was a small side alley.

sub_locations.name: Juth Alley
sub_locations.description: Juth Alley was a small side alley.

sub_locations.name: Shipwright's Square
sub_locations.description: Shipwright's Square was a small courtyard.

sub_locations.name: Ghemmer's Alley
sub_locations.description: Ghemmer's Alley was a small backalley.

sub_locations.name: Dancing Court
sub_locations.description: The Dancing Court was a cul-de-sac.

sub_locations.name: The Boomgarden
sub_locations.description: The Boomgarden was a cul-de-sac, paved in hard-packed earth and gravel.

sub_locations.name: Anchoret's Court
sub_locations.description: Anchoret's Court was a small courtyard.

sub_locations.name: Sethma's Court
sub_locations.description: Sethma's Court was a cobbled courtyard.

sub_locations.name: The Jar
sub_locations.description: The Jar was a small courtyard.

sub_locations.name: Tuckpurse Alley
sub_locations.description: Tuckpurse Alley was an alleyway of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

sub_locations.name: Gaustus Street
sub_locations.description:
Gaustus Street was a street of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

This street stretched from north to south, curving off of the [[Wall Way]] and terminating at the [[Court of the White Bull]].

sub_locations.name: Walltower Walk
sub_locations.description: Walltower Walk was a street of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

sub_locations.name: Cliffwatch
sub_locations.description: The Cliffwatch was a public walkway.

sub_locations.name: Sprangalar's Swordcut
sub_locations.description: Sprangalar's Swordcut, which was also simply called the Swordcut, was a small alley.

sub_locations.name: Howling Cat Court
sub_locations.description: Howling Cat Court was a small courtyard.

sub_locations.name: Mud Flats
sub_locations.description: The beach was frequented mostly by fishers, clam diggers, and occasional locals who enjoyed bathing in the cold waters of the [[Sea of Swords]].

sub_locations.name: Dead End Gate approx location
sub_locations.description: Secret entrance used by the Carver family for graveyard maintenance
